persona.backstory: She has stood at the small end of the ladder since before any of its rungs had numbers, and she writes down what each walker says about them.
persona.demeanor: Unhurried. Asks the question and then waits.
persona.motivation: Get every bay walked by somebody who will say whether it is the right size.
persona.secret: She has never agreed with the numbers she is asked to defend.
persona.speech_style: Plain, exact, faintly clerical; states measurements aloud.
